name: Orpheus
source:
Knight of the West country Œillet.
Born as a orphan, he travelled the land as a minstrel.
He has a bright attitude with a little bit of mischievousness.
He is very friendly, but on the inside he has a side of loneliness

His mansion is surrounded by nature and a beautiful lake. The living room is lined with plants and a stylish round window. All in all a refreshing
